title: The five-day week is a relic. Give us Fridays back.

defects.quote: Henry Ford adopted the five-day week for his factory workers in 1946
defects.correction: Ford Motor Company adopted the five-day, 40-hour week in 1926.

defects.quote: Employees on a four-day week are twice as productive per hour as those on five.
Since I personally get more done now that I take Fridays off, every company would benefit from a four-day week.
defects.known_rebuttal: Personal anecdote does not generalise. Reported gains come mostly from trials of self-selected, office-based firms, while shift-based and customer-facing work such as hospitals, retail and support must cover the same hours, so a shorter week there means hiring more staff or cutting service rather than free productivity.

defects.quote: It is not from the benevolence of the butcher, the brewer, or the baker, that we expect our dinner, but from their regard to their own interest.
defects.source_title: An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations by Adam Smith

defects.quote: Managers is often the last to be convinced
defects.correction: Managers are often the last to be convinced

defects.quote: Henry Ford adopted the five-day week for his factory workers in 1946, and he done it for profit, not kindness.
defects.note: 'done' should be 'did', but the sentence carries a wrong date, so the fact finding wins.
